notes: Availability annual values = 98% target + 'availability over target' read from the FY26 valuation report charts; these are RPC-certified/final values and differ slightly from provisional figures in presentations (e.g. FY23 PPTL 99.84% vs 99.83% in Q4FY23 deck; FY23 KATL 99.99% vs 100.00%).

VTL FY26: valuation report shows 99.48% (actual, reduced by NHAI road-diversion shutdown; financial impact borne by NHAI) while the Q4FY26 presentation shows 100.00% (treats the 96-hour third-party shutdown as deemed available). availability_annual uses 99.48%.
KATL FY26 availability is provisional per both the valuation report and presentation. KATL FY19 98.10% is confirmed by the FY22 valuation report and the Final Offer Document.

Partial first years are included in availability_annual and flagged in availability_annual_partial_year_flags (VTL FY17, KATL FY18, PPTL/WTL/JPTL FY19). First full operating years: VTL FY18, KATL FY19, PPTL/WTL/JPTL FY20. FY21 values come from the FY22/FY26 valuation charts.

Quarterly availability: discrete quarters are available only for 1Q-3Q FY23, 1Q-4Q FY24, 1Q-4Q FY25 and 1Q-3Q FY26. FY22 decks give only H1/9M/FY cumulative figures; Q4FY23 and Q4FY26 decks give only the full year; no Q1FY27 deck was available. Missing quarters are null (not derived). Cumulative-period figures are in availability_cumulative_periods. Some cumulative figures are internally inconsistent across decks (e.g. JPTL 9MFY24 99.92% vs H1 99.98% and Q3 100%) - recorded as printed.

Revenue FY23-FY26 = SPV revenue from operations (transmission charges incl. incentive/'performance bonus'; excl. other income) as disclosed project-wise in the annual report; it sums exactly to consolidated revenue from operations.

Revenue FY22 = full fiscal year (1-Apr-2021 to 31-Mar-2022) SPV revenue (AR FY22/FY23); the consolidated basis (13-May-2021 onward) is in revenue_other_periods. JPTL FY22 (Rs 293.8 cr) is well above FY23 (Rs 263.9 cr), likely due to change-in-law arrears after CERC order of 28-Oct-2021 (not explicitly stated). The AR FY2022-23 also prints an FY23 column of Rs 1,309.6 cr that includes SPV other income; the FY26 AR's ex-other-income FY23 figures are used instead.

Revenue FY18-FY20 from the IPO Final Offer Document (pre-InvIT, Sponsor ownership); FY21 full-year SPV revenue was not found (only 9MFY21 in revenue_other_periods). PPTL/WTL FY19-FY21 revenue includes change-in-law amounts that were then passed to POWERGRID; PPTL/WTL/JPTL bought these rights in Mar-2022.

EBITDA and EBITDA margin per SPV are NOT disclosed in any downloaded document (annual/half-yearly reports, presentations, valuation reports give only consolidated EBITDA) - left null. Only consolidated EBITDA is given under 'consolidated'.

PAT: SPV standalone PAT is disclosed only in the old-format SPV NDCF statements (FY22-FY24). FY25/FY26 use the new SEBI NDCF format (starts from operating cash flow), so PAT is null. (The AR FY2024-25 annexure reproducing the old format repeats the FY24 numbers labelled as FY25 - not used.) FY22 PAT is labelled 'year ended 31-Mar-2022' but the lower depreciation (e.g. VTL 227.94 vs 317.03 mn in FY23) suggests it may cover only the post-acquisition period from 13-May-2021.
Debt at 31-Mar-2026 for each SPV is entirely the shareholder loan from PGInvIT at 14.5% (intra-group). Trust-level external debt is Rs 1,064.03 cr (HDFC Bank, ~6.6-6.75%).

Acquisition: 74% of all five SPVs acquired 13-May-2021 (IPO, consideration paid in units); remaining 26% of VTL on 31-Mar-2022 and of KATL/PPTL/WTL/JPTL on 30-Dec-2024. Purchase prices from the FY26 valuation report.

Only VTL has an escalable tariff component (initial Rs 3.7 cr in 2017); FY26 valuation escalates it at 4.53% (FOD/IPO projections used 4.32%). PPTL/WTL/JPTL carry change-in-law uplifts of 2.79%/3.45%/5.23% on non-escalable charges. KATL has a separate RTM (regulated tariff) 125 MVAr bus reactor (COD 5-Feb-2024); PPTL has an RTM 400 kV bay (completed, DOCO pending).

The task pointed to ./uploads/ on the IPO resources page; that page actually links its PDFs under ./docs/ - the Final Offer Document was downloaded from https://www.pginvit.in/docs/IPO%20Resource/Final%20Offer%20Document.pdf.
